description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – Lexington, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Soft-top Snap Studs that screw into the Bed Side Wall of the Samurai.
There are 5 on each side of the bed so this will do one complete side.
OEM Part
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 5 – Snaps w/Threaded Posts for Samurai Body side
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1995 All Models
